decisions.reason: As a recent launch in a growing and R&D-active machinery business, this product still has option value and likely low holding cost while market feedback on industrial demand continues to emerge.
The product fits the firm's heat-exchange portfolio and decarbonization direction, so management would usually keep it on the market another year unless early sales evidence clearly disappoints.

Because it overlaps with another new air cooled condenser offering, it faces a somewhat higher risk of rationalization, but the firm would still tend to preserve the option until uncertainty resolves further.
